roman: Tu hai wo Ghaus ke har Ghaus hai shaida tera
Tu hai wo ghaith ke har ghaith hai pyaasa tera

Jo wali qabl the ya baad hue ya honge

Ke hua hai na wali ho koi hamta tera
Tujh se aur dehr ke aqtaab se nisbat kaisi
Qutb khud kaun hai khaadim tera chela tera
Saare aqtaab jahan karte hain Kaaba ka tawaf
Kaaba karta hai tawaf-e-dar-e-waala tera

Shama ek tu hai ke parwana hai Kaaba tera
Shajar-e-sarv sahi kis ke ugaaye tera
Ma'rifat phool sahi kis ka khilaaya tera
Tu hai naushah baraati hai ye saara gulzaar
Laai hai fasl-e-saman gondh ke sehra tera
Daaliyan jhoomti hain raqs-e-khushi josh pe hai
Bulbulen jhoolti hain gaati hain sehra tera
Geet kaliyon ki chatak ghazlen hazaaron ki chehak
Baagh ke saazon mein bajta hai taraana tera

Shakhen jhuk jhuk ke baja laati hain mujra tera
Kis gulistan ko nahin fasl-e-bahaari se niyaaz
Kaun se silsila mein faiz na aaya tera
Nahi kis chand ki manzil mein tera jalwa-e-noor
Nahi kis aaina ke ghar mein ujaala tera
Raaj kis sheher mein karte nahin tere khuddaam
Baaj kis nehr se leta nahin darya tera
Mazra-e-Chisht o Bukhara o Iraq o Ajmer
Kaun si kisht pe barsa nahin jhaala tera
Aur mehboob hain haan par sabhi yaksan to nahin
Yun to mehboob hai har chahne wala tera
Us ko so fard sarapa ba faraaghat odhen
Tang ho kar jo utarne ko ho neema tera
Gardane jhuk gayin sar jhuk gaye dil toot gaye
Kashf-e-saaq aaj kahan ye to qadam tha tera
Taaj-e-farq-e-urafa kis ke qadam ko kahiye

Nashe walon ne bhala sukr nikaala tera
Wo to chota hi kaha chaahen ke hain zer-e-hazeed
Aur har auj se uncha hai sitaara tera
Dil-e-ada ko Raza tez namak ki dhun hai
Ek zara aur chhidakta rahe khaama tera
